svg.title: R-fab-P - Fabrication Hall - plan
svg.text: The Fabrication Hall is the ship's own factory: it makes spare parts, tools and fittings from stock material and
from the baled metal and plastic of the recycling plant, so a failed part can be replaced in hours instead of
Design corner (east wall, south of the door)
Tool chests and parts wall (east wall, north of the door)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
